verdict.rationale: React exposes a thoroughly documented public JS API (components, hooks, JSX) that any developer or AI code-generation agent can use to drive UI construction, and react.dev even serves a machine-readable llms.txt feed. However, there is no REST/OpenAPI-style service API for programmatically 'operating' the product itself — probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404'd — so agentic control is limited to writing/generating code rather than invoking a formal external API.
